Latest News

Idea Exchange 2.0

09/25/26  When teammates from Government Secure & Intelligent Documents' (GSID) Washington, D.C., and Stennis, Mississippi, production facilities visit their sister location, they're doing more than observing another shop—they're sharing ideas, solving problems and building relationships that strengthen the Agency.

Passport Production Runs in the Family

09/25/26  As GPO Celebrates 100 Years of Producing the U.S. Passport, Families in D.C. and Stennis Share a Special Connection to the Work and Each Other.

New Mexico Supreme Court Law Library Named the Best in the Nation

09/22/26  The U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO) has named the New Mexico Supreme Court Law Library in Santa Fe, New Mexico, the 2026 Federal Depository Library of the Year. The library was selected for its exceptional commitment to providing free public access to Government information, preserving its collection, and serving communities throughout New Mexico.

GPO Names University of Colorado Boulder Libraries with Best Federal Depository Website

09/22/26  The U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO) honors the University of Colorado Boulder Libraries for having the best website in the Federal Depository Library Program (FDLP) for 2026. The award recognizes creativity and the ways libraries are providing easy access to Federal Government information on their websites.

GPO Launches New Annual Reports Collection on GovInfo

08/04/26  The U.S. Government Publishing Office (GPO) has launched a new Annual Reports collection on GovInfo, the one-stop site for authentic, published information for all three branches of the Federal Government. This release will make it easier to find and search for Annual Reports published by Federal agencies.

From Summer Intern to General Counsel

07/13/26  Since first joining the Agency as a summer intern in 1980, Kerry Miller has watched GPO evolve from a much larger, print-driven operation into the modern organization it is today. Along the way, he built a career in the Office of General Counsel and now serves as General Counsel.
